players.bio: Adam Daghim is a 20-year-old Danish professional footballer who plays as a winger for German Bundesliga club TSG Hoffenheim and the Denmark national team. Club career Daghim became the youngest AGF player to play in the Danish Superliga when he made his debut in a 0–0 draw with Vejle in April 2022. In the same month, he signed his first professional contract with the club.
Adam Hložek (born 25 July 2002) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a forward for Bundesliga club TSG Hoffenheim and the Czech Republic national team.

Albian Hajdari (born 18 May 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for German Bundesliga club TSG Hoffenheim. Born in Switzerland, he represented that nation at youth and senior international levels, before switching to play for the Kosovo national team in 2025.
Alexander Prass (born 26 May 2001) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder or left wing-back for German Bundesliga club TSG Hoffenheim and the Austria national team.

Andrej Kramarić (born 19 June 1991) is a Croatian professional footballer who plays as a forward or attacking midfielder for German club 1899 Hoffenheim and the Croatia national team. Kramarić started his football career in his hometown club Dinamo Zagreb and holds the record as the top youth goalscorer in the club's history.
Bambasé Conté (born 7 July 2003) is a German professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or a winger.
Bernardo Fernandes da Silva Junior (born 14 May 1995), known simply as Bernardo, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a full-back or centre-back for German club TSG 1899 Hoffenheim.

Cajetan Benjamin Lenz (born 16 June 2006) is a 19-year-old German-Swiss defensive midfielder. As of February 2026, he is considered one of Germany's top rising talents and has attracted significant interest from major European clubs.
Christian Ilzer (born 21 October 1977) is an Austrian professional football coach who is the manager of Bundesliga club TSG Hoffenheim.

Fisnik Asllani (born 8 August 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for German Bundesliga club TSG Hoffenheim. A former international for Kosovo U17, he played for the Germany national youth teams in a pair of friendlies before switching back to play for the Kosovo national team.
Ihlas Bebou (born 23 April 1994) is a Togolese footballer who plays as a winger or forward for TSG 1899 Hoffenheim in the Bundesliga.

Kōki Machida (born 25 August 1997) is a Japanese professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Bundesliga club TSG Hoffenheim and the Japan national team. Machida joined J1 League club Kashima Antlers in 2016. On 25 May, he debuted in J.League Cup, in a match against Júbilo Iwata.

Leon Avdullahu (born 23 February 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for German Bundesliga club TSG Hoffenheim. Born in Switzerland, he represented that nation at youth international levels but in 2025 switched to play for Kosovo national team.
Luca Philipp was born on 28 November 2000 in Stuttgart and plays for TSG 1899 Hoffenheim. He played for SGV Freiberg from 2012-2013 and has played for TSG Hoffenheim since 2013.
Mats Rots (born 11 March 2006) is a Dutch professional football player who plays as a left-back for German Bundesliga club TSG Hoffenheim.
Max Moerstedt (born 15 January 2006) is a German footballer who plays as a striker for TSG 1899 Hoffenheim.

Oliver Baumann (German pronunciation: ; born 2 June 1990 in Breisach) is a German professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Bundesliga club TSG Hoffenheim, where he is also captain, and the Germany national team.
Ozan Muhammed Kabak (born 25 March 2000) is a Turkish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Bundesliga club 1899 Hoffenheim and the Turkey national team.
Patrick Wimmer (born 30 May 2001) is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a right winger for Bundesliga club VfL Wolfsburg and the Austria national team.
Robin Hranáč (born 29 January 2000) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a defender for Bundesliga club TSG Hoffenheim and the Czech Republic national team.
Tim Lemperle (born 5 February 2002) is a German professional footballer who plays as a forward for Bundesliga club TSG Hoffenheim.
Valentin André Stanislas Gendrey (born 21 June 2000) is a French professional footballer who plays as a right-back for German Bundesliga club TSG Hoffenheim.

Vladimír Coufal (born 22 August 1992) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a right-back for German Bundesliga club Hoffenheim and for the Czech Republic national team. He has previously played for Bílovec, Hlučín, Opava, Slovan Liberec and Slavia Prague.
Wouter Burger (born 16 February 2001) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a central or defensive midfielder for German Bundesliga club TSG Hoffenheim.
